title: Creamy Dijon Mushroom and Lentils Over Farro
intro: Trading heavy cream and beef for nonfat Greek yogurt and lentils turns a classic stroganoff into a satisfying weekday dinner. This earthy dish delivers a comforting tang alongside plenty of plant-based protein and fiber.

ingredients.name: cremini mushrooms
ingredients.canonical_name: Mushrooms, brown, italian, or crimini, raw

ingredients.name: low-sodium vegetable broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, vegetable broth, ready to serve

ingredients.name: no-salt-added canned brown lentils
ingredients.canonical_name: Lentils, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply browned and the moisture evaporates.
Stir in the garlic and thyme, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the broth and mustard, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low, stir in the lentils, and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove the skillet from the heat.
Warm the farro in the microwave according to the pouch directions. Let the lentil skillet cool off the heat, then stir in the yogurt until smoothly combined so it does not curdle.
Divide the warm farro between serving bowls, top with the mushroom and lentil mixture, and garnish with the walnuts.
variation: Swap the farro for a ready-to-eat brown rice pouch.
conservation: Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat gently over low heat.
